Braze produces a lot of content — marketing campaigns, blog posts, customer stories, courses, lessons, documentation — and most of it is still written, reviewed, and published the way it was five years ago.

AI changes what's possible here, but only if someone owns the work of figuring out which parts of the content workflow actually benefit from automation, building the tools, and getting them into people's daily hands. That's this role.

You'll own the AI content operations product roadmap inside Content Platforms: identifying where content creators spend time on work that doesn't add proportional value, designing tools that remove the friction, shipping those tools into the Sanity CMS and the broader content stack, and driving adoption with the marketing and learning teams that use them.Teams across Braze are just starting to figure out how AI fits into their day-to-day work.

There is no settled playbook, and the people closest to the business problems — the writers, designers, instructional designers, marketers, and operators making content every day — are the ones discovering what's possible. Your job is to learn from them first.

The good ideas will not come out of an abstract roadmap exercise; they will come out of sitting next to people doing the work, watching where they get stuck, and noticing the small AI-powered moves they're already making on their own.This is not a research role and it's not a presentations role.

You'll write code, ship prototypes, pair with engineers, and measure adoption. AI-assisted development is how we work — you'll be expected to use it, build with it, and be opinionated about it.
You'll sit on the Content Platforms team as a senior individual contributor. No direct reports, but a strong remit to lead — setting direction, raising the bar, and pulling colleagues across teams toward better solutions.
Room To Grow
The role itself is Senior TPM, Content Platforms — the parenthetical reflects initial focus, not permanent scope. The team owns a broader technical content operations remit, and as this work matures we expect the role to expand into adjacent problem areas. The right candidate sees AI content operations as a way in, not the whole job.
Why This Role Matters For You
The job most product managers say they want — owning a real product, shipping it, watching adoption climb — is hard to find inside a large company. This role is one of them. Content Platforms is a small, fast-moving team. The marketing and learning organizations are real customers with real pain points. The tools you ship will land in people's daily workflow within weeks of shipping, not quarters.
You'll also be in a rare seat in terms of timing. The content operations function is in the middle of a hard reset around AI, and most of the people deciding how that plays out at enterprise scale are doing it badly. This role puts you in a position to shape how it gets done at Braze — and to develop the judgment that will be in short supply across the industry for a long time.
This is a role for people who'd rather build the tools than write a deck about them.

Embed with marketing and learning teams to deeply understand how content actually gets made — research, drafting, review, publishing, optimization — and where the friction lives. We're looking for a Product Manager to help shape the future of Klaviyo's Checkout Experience.
In this role, you'll own key parts of the customer purchasing journey, with a primary focus on improving checkout conversion and reducing friction throughout the buying experience. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Growth to build intuitive experiences that help more customers successfully evaluate, purchase, and activate Klaviyo.
You'll use customer research, experimentation, and product analytics to identify opportunities to simplify the purchasing flow, improve conversion, and deliver a best-in-class SaaS checkout experience. You'll also have the opportunity to work on adjacent areas including subscriptions, billing, promotions, payment experiences, and integrations with platforms like Stripe as the product continues to evolve.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving customer problems, shipping polished user experiences, and using data to drive measurable business outcomes.

Own product initiatives across Klaviyo's customer checkout experience, with a focus on increasing conversion and reducing friction throughout the purchasing journey.
Build intuitive purchasing experiences that help customers confidently select a plan, complete checkout, and activate their subscription.
Partner with Design and Engineering to continuously improve the checkout flow through customer research, usability testing, experimentation, and iterative product development.
Analyze conversion funnels, customer behavior, and product metrics to identify opportunities for improvement and measure business impact.
Collaborate with Growth, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success to support new purchasing experiences, pricing experiments, and go-to-market initiatives.
Help evolve adjacent experiences including subscriptions, billing, promotions, payment methods, customer self-service, and payment recovery where they improve the overall customer experience.
Partner with Engineering on integrations with payment platforms such as Stripe and other supporting infrastructure as needed.
Define product success metrics and use experimentation to continuously improve customer outcomes.

4+ years of product management experience building B2B customer-facing SaaS products.
You’re obsessed with optimizing the growth funnel and have experience owning user journeys where conversion, onboarding, growth, or customer experience were primary success metrics.
Experience with SaaS checkout UX, purchasing flows, subscription products, PLG, growth, onboarding, or monetization is highly preferred.
Experience with subscription billing, payment platforms (such as Stripe, Metronome, Paypal, Chargbee), to manage promotions, pricing experimentation, or payment recovery is a plus—but not required.
Strong product intuition around UX and customer experience, with a passion for simplifying complex workflows.
You’re data-first and AI-native. Comfortable using experimentation, funnel analysis, customer research, and analytics to inform product decisions.
Excellent cross-functional partner who enjoys working closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and GTM teams.
Curious, collaborative, and excited to build products that have measurable customer and business impact.
You have a point-of-view on the Billing, Payments, and Monetization Landscape and how it supports the Growth lever at a Public Company.
High ownership and follow‑through : you reliably drive work from “vague problem” to shipped outcome, turning feedback and ambiguity into clear next steps.

Checkout is one of the highest-leverage moments in the customer journey. Every improvement to the purchasing experience—whether reducing friction, increasing conversion, or making it easier for customers to activate and manage their subscription—has a direct impact on customer growth and business outcomes.
In this role, you'll help shape how thousands of businesses experience Klaviyo from their very first purchase. By building intuitive, data-driven checkout experiences and continuously optimizing the customer journey through experimentation and customer insights, you'll play a key role in driving acquisition, improving customer satisfaction, and supporting Klaviyo's next phase of growth.

Own and drive the KDS product strategy — enterprise workflow depth, data differentiation, SMB attach growth, and the agentic AI roadmap — connecting investments to Toast's kitchen adoption vision and near-term business outcomes including ARR growth, support ticket reduction, and enterprise retention.
Define where agentic AI creates real value in the kitchen: proactive prep time adjustments based on real-time order load, automatic kitchen configuration changes tied to labor schedules or ordering channel mix, intelligent ticket routing and load balancing — and build the investment case to pursue the highest-leverage bets.
Own KDS delivery end-to-end, working directly with large restaurant groups to translate complex, high-stakes workflow requirements into scalable product decisions that serve the whole market.
Lead the KDS kitchen data strategy: define what kitchen efficiency insights should look like for operators at every scale, from API-first analytics for enterprise operators to actionable reporting for SMBs, and sequence the investments to unlock it.
Shape and validate the business case for the next-generation KDS strategy — the long-horizon bets that drive future growth.

Proven experience defining and owning product strategy for a complex, operationally critical product — bonus points if it spans hardware and software and/or have experience in food & beverage.
Creative and strategic: you don't just optimize existing products — you identify the next meaningful bet, make the case for it, and drive it from zero to conviction.
Curiosity and a point of view on AI and agentic product opportunities in operational environments — you don't need to have shipped an agent, but you should have a clear perspective on where autonomous action creates real value vs. real risk.
Track record of working directly with enterprise customers, translating nuanced, high-stakes workflow requirements into product decisions that scale well beyond a single logo.
Strong instincts for the SMB operator: you understand what it means to run a restaurant kitchen without a data analyst, an IT team, or a change management budget — and you can build for that reality.

We are looking for a Senior Principal Product Manager to own and drive consequential charters within Toast Enterprise Core Platform. This is not a contributing role — it is full charter ownership, end-to-end. Senior Principal PM is the most senior individual contributor level in Product Management at Toast. At this level, you are expected to operate with the scope and strategic impact of a director while remaining deeply hands-on with the product.

You will be based in Bengaluru and embedded in our India R&D organization, with meaningful partnership with product, engineering, go-to-market, and customer teams across the company.

Toast's largest enterprise customers require features that cut across multiple engineering codebases — features that no single platform team owns end-to-end. The Away Team exists to build those features: shipping enterprise capabilities inside codebases owned by other Toast teams, on behalf of customers whose operational requirements don't fit neatly into any single team's roadmap.

This is a cross-cutting, complex, and high-leverage product charter critical to our success. Full charter ownership here means you define what gets built, in which system, with what sequencing — and you hold the accountability for delivery across all of it.

Why This Role

· Full ownership, not a slice. You own two complete charters, end-to-end. The Away Team and Enterprise Reporting are yours to define, drive, and deliver — with the scope and strategic altitude that comes with the most senior IC PM level at the company.

· Genuinely unsolved problems. The cross-codebase delivery model and enterprise analytics vision are not solved problems at Toast. You will be writing the playbook, not executing one that already exists.

· Customers that run at scale. The enterprise brands on our customer list operate hundreds to thousands of locations worldwide. Your roadmap decisions directly affect how those businesses run.

· Bengaluru is a first-class org. The Away Team is based here. Toast's India R&D hub has full product and engineering ownership — this is not offshore execution. You will be at the center of it.

· Visibility to executive leadership. The Enterprise segment is a company-level priority. This role has direct exposure to VP/GM leadership and regular involvement in executive-level roadmap and strategy discussions.

· India hours, global impact. You will operate primarily from Bengaluru, owning product that runs in markets across the US and internationally — with the credibility and organizational standing to match.

About the Enterprise Segment at Toast

Toast Enterprise serves the largest and most complex restaurant and hospitality operators in the world — multi-location brands that require centralized management, enterprise-grade controls, multi-concept reporting, and deep third-party integrations. Our 2026 product investment themes span Reporting & AI Innovation, Enterprise Controls, In-Store Experience, and Guest Experience. Our hospitality segment delivered 115% year-over-year growth in 2025 and continues to scale rapidly.

The Bengaluru R&D team ships enterprise product across multiple codebases, partners closely with US-based platform teams, and owns an increasing share of the Enterprise product surface. This role sits at the center of that organization.

Embrace and advocate for the use of AI tools to accelerate product discovery, streamline execution, and explore new product experiences - helping shape how we build and what we build.

· Drive cross-codebase delivery. Partner with engineering and product owners across Toast's platform teams to ship enterprise features in their systems. Navigate competing roadmaps, set clear success criteria, and hold delivery against contractual commitments.

· Define the enterprise reporting vision. Understand deeply how multi-location restaurant operators measure performance and make decisions. Translate that understanding into a multi-year roadmap for enterprise-grade reporting — one that positions Toast as the data platform our largest customers depend on.

· Represent enterprise customers at the highest level. You will be the PM voice for some of the world's largest restaurant and hospitality brands in roadmap discussions, cross-functional reviews, and executive conversations. These are customers with signed contractual commitments and high expectations.

· Operate across Bengaluru and the US. Partner daily with engineering, UX, solutions, go-to-market, and customer success across Bengaluru and US-based teams. This role requires consistent US Eastern Time overlap.

· Contribute to Enterprise strategy. Your two charters — cross-platform delivery and analytics — sit at the intersection of every other Enterprise product charter. You will have a seat at the table on long-range planning, investment decisions, and what Enterprise looks like in three years.

· 15+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years in enterprise or B2B SaaS — specifically owning complex product surface areas, not contributing to them.

· Track record of driving delivery that required cross-team coordination across engineering organizations that did not report to you. Influence without authority is core to this role.

· Experience owning analytics, reporting, or data platform products — with a clear point of view on what makes enterprise reporting genuinely differentiated vs. table stakes.

· Exceptional written communication. You move decisions forward with documents; you don't wait for meetings to create alignment.

· Ability to maintain occasional US Eastern Time overlap (approximately 5:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST).

· Comfort with ambiguity at the charter level — you have shaped product direction from scratch, not just executed against someone else's vision.

· Commercial instincts. You understand how product decisions translate into revenue, retention, and customer value, and you make prioritization decisions accordingly.

· Background in restaurant technology, hospitality, retail, or an adjacent industry with multi-location or franchise business model complexity.

· Experience working in or alongside India-based engineering teams as part of a global product organization.

· Familiarity with data infrastructure, analytics engineering, or enterprise BI tooling at scale.

· Prior experience at Staff, Principal, or Distinguished PM level — or equivalent IC track at a top-tier technology company.

· Experience managing product commitments that are tied to enterprise contracts or MSAs.

About Marqeta
Marqeta is on a mission to change the way money moves. We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time.

Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all.
Marqeta’s Values
· Solve for the Customer: With a deep understanding of our customers' business and empathy for their needs, we deliver products and services that drive their success. Earning and keeping their trust guides everything we do.

We're looking for a Lead Product Manager, Enterprise AI and Automation to lead how Marqeta identifies, governs, and scales AI and automation across the organization. Reporting into the Business Technology (IT) organization, you will own the internal enterprise platform strategy, focusing on employee-facing tooling that drives productivity and efficiency for our internal teams.

You'll collaboratively design the AI vision for the enterprise, partner to build the governance and adoption frameworks that make it real, and work hands-on to evaluate tools, run pilots, and drive measurable business value. You'll partner closely with business unit leaders, the AI Steering Committee, and BT engineering to ensure AI initiatives are prioritized against the highest-impact problems — and that what gets built is driven to adoption.

This is not a research role or a strategy-only role. The right person is equally comfortable presenting an AI governance framework to the executive team and rolling up their sleeves to configure an agent, evaluate a vendor, or run a pilot with a business unit.

We work Flexible First . This role can be performed remotely in the United States, only in one of our National locations, which you can review here .

The Impact You’ll Have

Internal AI & Automation Strategy

· Collaboratively define Marqeta's Enterprise AI & automation strategy, including responsible AI principles, governance frameworks, and a multi-quarter adoption roadmap.

· Partner across the business to identify and prioritize high-value AI and automation use cases for each business unit.

· Map how work flows across the enterprise to identify where AI can deliver step-change improvements — not just incremental automation, but fundamentally better ways of operating.

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. Product at Baseten
Product at Baseten is a nascent function. Our company today has a strong engineering culture, is heavily customer-obsessed, and moves fast. We're building the product function now, and you'd be one of the first people who will help define it.

You'll work directly with our founders and with some of the best systems and infrastructure engineers in the world, and you'll set the standard for building great AI Infrastructure.

PMs at Baseten don't sit above engineers - you earn ownership by being technical, finding the truth in front of customers, building great cross-functional relationships, and shipping great product experiences.

Getting a model into production still takes real expertise — choosing a serving engine, sizing hardware, tuning it, wiring it into an app. We want a developer to go from "it runs on my laptop" to "it's serving production traffic" in minutes, on their own.

You'll own the entire experience a developer touches to deploy and iterate: the CLI and SDKs, the console, onboarding, model discovery, deployment configuration, truss, and the increasingly agent-driven ways developers build.

Your job is to make Baseten synonymous with Great DevEx and make it effortless to drive and self-serve deploy models on Baseten for far more developers than it is today.
Impact and outcomes you'll drive
You will collapse time-to-production — take a developer from first sign-up to a running, maintained production deployment, and drive down the time it takes to get there.

About Faire
Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline.

At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores.

With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

Faire's financial products are among the most powerful and differentiated value props we offer — and among the most consequential for both sides of our marketplace. We extend net-60 and net-90 payment terms to retailers on behalf of brands, offer the Faire Pay credit card with 3% back on purchases, and are actively building brand financing.

These products do something our partners simply cannot do on their own: absorb risk, deploy capital efficiently, and unlock purchasing behavior that drives growth across the platform.
We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the entire Faire Pay portfolio — someone who can run disciplined day-to-day execution on Faire Pay while simultaneously developing the longer-term strategic roadmap for how financial products evolve as a core business line. This means thinking clearly about unit economics and cost of capital, building conviction around where Faire has durable competitive advantages, and shipping products that move real business metrics.

Own strategy and roadmap for Faire's financial products. Set the multi-year direction for how Faire Pay, net terms, brand financing, and future financial products evolve, and build the prioritized, financially grounded roadmap to get there.
Drive Faire Pay adoption and marketplace impact. Expand the invited retailer cohort, improve activation and retention across the funnel, and demonstrate that financial products are a meaningful growth lever for the core marketplace, not just a standalone offering.
Own the unit economics. Think in contribution margin, cost of capital, and payback periods. Optimize interchange, manage loss rates, and identify where structural advantages exist versus where we need to earn our way in.
Partner deeply across Finance, Risk, Legal, Data Science, and Engineering. Earn trust across functions, lead without authority, and keep complex, multi-stakeholder work moving without losing momentum.
Build the infrastructure for scale. Partner to develop the data infrastructure, risk frameworks, and operational foundations needed to grow financial products responsibly, from underwriting logic to regulatory compliance.
Communicate clearly at every altitude. Translate complex, technical topics (cost of capital, credit risk, underwriting tradeoffs) for a wide range of audiences, from engineering partners to senior leadership.

10+ years of product management experience, with demonstrated ability to own complex, cross-functional products end to end.
Genuine fintech depth. You've built and shipped financial products — credit, lending, payments, BNPL, or similar — and you understand the mechanics: underwriting logic, cost of capital, credit risk, contribution margin, and regulatory constraints. You don't need to be a finance expert, but you need to be able to lead the room.
Business equation fluency. You think comfortably in unit economics. You can model whether a new product makes sense given Faire's cost of capital, estimate cohort-level payback periods, and identify structural advantages worth betting on.
Strategic clarity with hands-on execution. You can zoom out and develop a defensible multi-year point of view, then zoom back in to write crisp PRDs, drive sprint-level execution, and unblock your team.
Customer and business model empathy. You deeply understand how retailers and brands run their businesses — their cash flow cycles, how they think about credit and payment terms, and what makes them trust a financial product. You design around customer needs, not just what's technically feasible.
Cross-functional influence across Finance, Risk, Legal, Data Science, and Engineering, and a track record of aligning diverse stakeholders while maintaining momentum.
Structured problem solving. You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, don't mistake activity for progress, and diagnose root causes rather than escalate.
High learning velocity. Financial products sit at the intersection of marketplace dynamics, risk, and regulatory complexity.
Proven ability to influence at the executive level and to communicate complex topics with clarity and conviction across audiences.
B2B marketplace experience is a strong plus — particularly familiarity with two-sided dynamics, competing customer objectives, and the structural differences between B2B and consumer credit.

Tracking and understanding retailers — the data and insights brands use to know who their most valuable customers are and how to grow with them.

About MetaMask
MetaMask is building a future where users can unlock the full product stack through a single, seamless identity experience, enabling access to all features with trust, safety, and minimal friction.
Today, identity verification is fragmented across several product and onboarding experiences. Users are repeatedly asked to verify themselves across different services, creating unnecessary friction, inconsistent outcomes, and degraded trust.
Universal KYC (UKYC) is a new initiative to solve this problem by creating a single, reusable identity layer across MetaMask. At the centre of this is MetaMask Passport , a product designed to enable users to verify once and unlock multiple experiences across the MetaMask ecosystem.
This role sits at the intersection of platform and product experience . You will define the primitives, standards, and user journeys that make identity verification seamless, privacy-conscious, and globally compliant.

You will own the vision and roadmap for Universal KYC and MetaMask Passport, defining how a reusable identity layer unlocks the broader MetaMask product stack. You will build the underlying identity platform, creating scalable verification primitives and standards that can be adopted across products.

In parallel, you will design a seamless, low-friction KYC experience that reduces time-to-first-transaction while maintaining compliance integrity. You will drive adoption across MetaMask by partnering closely with internal teams to integrate a consistent identity layer, while balancing privacy, trust, and global regulatory requirements.

Throughout, you will lead execution end-to-end, aligning cross-functional teams and delivering measurable outcomes.

Proven experience building or scaling identity verification (IDV), KYC, or onboarding products
Strong background in fintech , ideally with exposure to Web3
Hands-on experience working with identity verification providers (IDV vendors) such as Sumsub, Veriff, Onfido, Persona, or Stripe Identity
Familiarity with compliance workflows , including KYC, KYB, and customer due diligence (CDD) processes
Track record of delivering platform products adopted across multiple teams
Ability to operate across both technical systems and user experience

Increased KYC completion rates and reduced onboarding friction
Reduced time-to-first-transaction across KYC-gated flows
Increased reuse of verified identity across products
Improved transaction success rate through consistent verification outcomes
Strong user trust with minimal friction and compliant execution

Deep user empathy with a focus on reducing friction and cognitive load
Strong understanding of trust, privacy, and compliance trade-offs
Clear, structured communicator who drives alignment and momentum
High ownership and ability to operate in ambiguity

Universal KYC is a foundational unlock for MetaMask, enabling users to move from fragmented, repetitive identity verification to a seamless, reusable experience across the entire product stack. It establishes a scalable, privacy-conscious identity layer that strengthens user trust while meeting global compliance requirements. This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of access, trust, and growth, critical to unlocking the next phase of MetaMask’s evolution.

This is an exciting time to join Remote and shape the future of reporting and insights as the Senior Product Manager, Reporting & Insights .
Your mission: enable customers and internal teams to answer critical workforce, payroll, finance, and compliance questions with confidence through trusted, well-designed reporting and insights experiences.
Working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, GTM, Sales, Customer Success, Security, Legal, and Operations, you will bring the customer judgment, technical depth, and product craft needed to build reporting that is accurate, scalable, easy to use, and ready for AI-assisted workflows and insights.
You report to a Senior Group Product Manager and collaborate daily with cross-functional partners to ensure every reporting and insights capability succeeds commercially, technically, and operationally.

Senior-Level Experience: Track record as a Product Manager with a strong focus on reporting, analytics, data platforms, workflow, or insights products .
Proficiency in Cursor and/or Claude Code (Required): You must be able to autonomously build, debug, and ship functional code and prototypes — not just write specs. You can understand data schemas, query patterns, analytics code, and AI-assisted workflows hands-on.
Data Understanding & Fluency (Required): Strong end-to-end data literacy across models/schemas, lineage, and report generation. Comfortable with grain/joins/aggregations and common pitfalls (double-counting, currency/timezones, effective dating, late-arriving data).
Able to read/write SQL to validate results, investigate discrepancies, and ensure metrics are well-defined, reconciled, and trustworthy. Partner effectively with Data/Engineering to resolve definition and modeling issues.
Customer Focus: Deep empathy for customers and a strong sense of what matters most in their day-to-day workflows.
Stakeholder Management: Strong ability to align cross-functional stakeholders, navigate trade-offs, and keep teams focused on what matters most for customers.
Strong UX Sensibilities: A passion for effortless experiences. You believe that complex data, reporting, and insights workflows should feel simple, trustworthy, and useful to the end user.
Outstanding Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can explain complex data, reporting, AI, and compliance trade-offs to non-technical executives and clearly articulate value to customers and internal stakeholders.
Language: Business-level proficiency writing and speaking English.

Set the reporting and insights strategy: Define the vision and roadmap for a multi-surface reporting system across in-app report building, dashboards, scheduled delivery, exports, APIs/connectors, embedded partner surfaces, and AI/agent experiences.
Deeply understand customer reporting needs: Build empathy for payroll, finance, HR, executive, manager, internal operator, and partner/builder personas — translating different workflows, trust thresholds, and AI readiness levels into clear product priorities.
Build trusted reporting foundations: Own payroll-grade reporting capabilities including standard reports, configurable report building, GL/journal exports, variance reporting, reconciliation, definitions, permissions, lineage, auditability, and observability.
Develop intelligent insights experiences: Identify where AI, anomaly detection, driver analysis, and proactive recommendations can help users understand what changed and what to do next — while keeping outputs explainable, source-backed, and compliant.
Deliver through strong cross-functional execution: Partner with Data, Engineering, Design, Security, Legal, Sales, CX, Finance, Operations, and partners to turn customer needs into technically sound, scalable reporting solutions.

This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Senior Product Manager, Fraud and Compliance, joining the Fintech area
As Remote grows and handles larger transaction volumes across countries, so does our exposure to fraud, credit risk, and compliance risk. This role owns the systems and strategies that protect Remote and its customers — from onboarding verification and screening, to credit risk assessment and reserve management, to fraud detection and enforcement across the full customer lifecycle.
You'll drive the evolution of our risk and compliance capabilities from reactive, rule-based controls toward proactive, automated systems that identify risk signals early and scale without proportional increases in manual effort. Seasoned Product Manager, with a track record on platform, API, or products for operational teams.
Platform mindset. You build systems others can extend. Scalability means growing the business without proportional increases in manual work or complexity.
Strong UX sensibilities . Risk and compliance tooling doesn't have to be painful. You care about the admin experience as much as the customer-facing one.

Data-driven decision-making. Comfortable querying data and working with visualisation tools, you let insights drive your prioritisation.

Great judgment - making strategic (what to prioritize) and tactical (feature scope) decisions.

Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale.

With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions.

Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost.

We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals.

You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.
Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

As the Senior Product Manager for Infrastructure Observability (Infra O11y) you’ll be responsible for our most popular Grafana Cloud products that span the infrastructure suite: Kubernetes Monitoring and Cloud Provider Observability. Infra O11y provides our customers with the ability to easily monitor their core services – from our smallest self-serve customers to our largest enterprise customers.
Your primary responsibility will be to help define the vision and ensure the long-term success of Infra O11y, working with your engineering partners to fine-tune product strategy. You will be charting the path forward for net-new product initiatives – like Host Monitoring – balanced with maintaining a strong roadmap and customer satisfaction for our most mature products.
Your role will require heavy customer discovery, understanding user needs, and building consensus and alignment across several Engineering groups and many stakeholders as we look towards simplifying our broader Infra O11y experience for Grafana Cloud. You will also need to flex your GTM muscles and build conviction in areas like competitive analysis and sales enablement to better inform activities like pricing and packaging.
Beyond driving your individual product area, you’ll also need to ensure that the experiences you’re building are tightly woven into our overall Grafana Cloud suite of products, by establishing integration touchpoints with other key offerings like Grafana Cloud Knowledge Graph and Grafana Assistant, so that our customers have a seamless monitoring experience where they can easily navigate between different layers of their architecture through guided explorations and natural language.

Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering

s.h: What makes you a great fit
s.t:
A BS/BA in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
7+ years of experience in Product Management
5+ years of experience in a B2B SaaS product
Experience using or building developer-facing tools, APIs, or platform services
Ability to discuss APIs, data models, schema evolution, and distributed systems concepts
Experience driving adoption of shared services or platform capabilities across multiple product teams
Experience working with Engineering and Design teams build delightful products and features – with sounds UX – in a fast-paced environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

Experience with open source software and/or commercial open source companies
Experience using or building observability products and/or developer tools, either internally as an SRE or for external customers
Proficient with infrastructure concepts and components – like Kubernetes, Cloud Service Providers, and VMs – and able to articulate these models in human-readable terms
Experience with AI tools

Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. s.h: About the role: What's in the Box
s.t:
This position is for a Principal Product Manager to hold accountability for the referral product: the experience across digital apps and websites, the behavioral mechanics that encourage customers to invite others, and the underlying systems that support experimentation and continuous improvement.

The service provider will partner closely with Marketing to build experiences that drive commercial outcomes. Beyond the traditional program, there is genuine room to develop new forms of viral growth that expand past traditional referral models.
The referrals domain—one of the most critical channels for acquiring new subscribers—lives within the Engagement tribe. This tribe focuses on deepening relationships between consumers and core brands as the product ecosystem evolves into a daily kitchen companion. This is a highly visible mandate that receives sustained attention from senior leadership. This role does not include people management responsibilities.
At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to the delivery of services. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.
At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.

Drive accountability for the vision, roadmap, and strategic direction for the referral product across app and web platforms, alongside behavioral mechanics that turn engagement into referral growth.
Build the metric framework that connects customer experience to referral behavior and, in partnership with Marketing, to commercial outcomes.
Design the sharing mechanics , including incentives, rewards, and milestone moments that encourage user referrals.
Optimize the referral journey end to end , from the initial sharing trigger through to the finalized acquisition of new users.
Push beyond the legacy referral program to build new engines for viral growth, such as mechanisms that enable customers to create and distribute brand-aligned content within their own networks.
Establish a fast experimentation practice to isolate key product levers, run clean tests, and efficiently decommission low-performing features.
Partner with marketing and CRM teams to integrate programmatic communications—including push notifications, in-app messaging, and email—into the core referral experience.
Collaborate closely with commercial counterparts on reward economics and promotional offer strategies.
Engage directly with C-level and senior leadership to communicate product direction, defend strategic tradeoffs, and report delivery results.

Significant experience as a product lead at a large-scale B2C company, with a proven track record of building consumer products at scale and a strong intuition for customer behavior and emotional drivers.
Direct experience in referrals, virality, or growth marketing loops , showing a comprehensive understanding of how to optimize user acquisition systems. Experience with products featuring built-in organic viral growth is a strong plus.

HelloFresh Ireland is in an exciting growth phase - expanding customer choice, deepening menu relevance, and driving long-term loyalty in a fast-growing market. As our Senior Product Manager, you will own the product space, driving impact across product strategy, product operations, and culinary workstreams. You will lead a talented, dedicated team and serve as the strategic engine behind what makes our boxes brilliant for Irish customers.

This is not a technology product role. You will work across the full value chain - from ingredient sourcing and culinary development through to menu strategy, editorial execution, and customer experience - making decisions that directly impact what lands on our customers' doorsteps every week. You will need the ability to operate at pace, cut through complexity, and bring teams and stakeholders with you.

· Strategic business planning: Reviewing product KPIs and guiding the team to improve the product offering - balancing short-term operations with long-term strategic direction, and owning the product investment calendar to increase retention while optimising for revenue and costs.

· A bias for action - moving quickly without sacrificing quality, bringing momentum to the teams around you.

· Sharp problem-solving instincts - comfortable with ambiguity and confident driving toward solutions.

· At home in lean, agile environments - able to do more with less and build from the ground up.

· Comfortable in Excel and Google Suite.

s.h: About the role: What's in the Box
s.t:
As a Staff Product Manager, you will own and evolve HelloFresh's benefit creation platform, which defines, configures, and governs every discount, voucher, and reward across all our global brands and channels. Leading a dedicated squad of engineers, you will transform this high-impact system into a flexible, scalable, and highly automated platform.

This is a foundational infrastructure role where you will design self-serve tooling and robust governance rules, ensuring our marketing and commercial teams can safely launch campaigns without engineering bottlenecks. Your work will directly protect our P&L margins while unlocking innovative, automated capabilities for future customer experiences.

Define the long-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for our global benefit and incentive platform, setting the path toward intelligent, automated creation tools.
Design scalable platform primitives and reusable building blocks to eliminate custom, one-off engineering for individual marketing campaigns.
Establish automated governance layers, including margin floors and stacking checks, to systematically protect business profitability.
Build intuitive back-office tooling that enables commercial and growth teams to configure standard campaigns independently.
Drive cross-functional alignment across international teams, encouraging adoption of a unified platform contract.
Evaluate and implement automation and smart interfaces where they bring the highest return on investment, balancing flexibility with system reliability.

Extensive experience in platform product management is essential, with a proven track record of building scalable internal tools, APIs, or foundational infrastructure rather than just user-facing features.
You bring 6+ years of product management experience, specifically operating already at a Senior or Staff level within complex systems across multiple markets or diverse business lines.
Exceptional leadership and communication skills are required to align senior, cross-functional stakeholders and champion platform adoption without direct authority.
It is a strong advantage if you bring a background in commercial strategy or promotional economics, enabling you to design smart business guardrails that balance marketing flexibility with P&L protection.
Familiarity with data analysis and technical architecture is highly valued, helping you effectively design reliable automation and interpret experiment data alongside engineering teams.

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to own and evolve HelloFresh's customer prediction and decisioning portfolio, the suite of ML products that forecast customer value and, increasingly, decide the next best action for every customer: the right action, message, or nudge, for the right person, on the right channel, at the right moment.
You'll lead a squad of Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers on a mission to build the AI-powered engine that decides how HelloFresh creates and protects customer value across millions of customers and multiple markets.

In this role, you will evolve our customer prediction and decisioning portfolio from a passive measurement layer that predicts value into an active engine that prescribes and orchestrates the actions that create it, moving from generic, rules-based segmentation to a sophisticated predict-and-optimize system that pairs models of each customer's lifetime value and incremental response with optimization that spends finite budget and attention where it returns the most.

Your scope spans the entire customer journey: from first discovery to reacquisition and active retention, across every owned channel.
This is a commercial decision-making role, not a single-surface personalization role. CLV is the prediction that powers it; next-best-action is what we do with it. You will own both the prediction layer and the decisioning/orchestration layer that turns predictions into action.
You will advocate for a customer-centric philosophy: optimization as empowerment, not manipulation. Working backwards from customer needs, you'll ensure our AI helps customers make better-informed decisions, with rigorous standards around transparency, privacy, and fairness. Trust is our primary growth lever when customers feel understood, it drives long-term retention, higher order frequency, and advocacy.
You will serve as the voice of the customer and the single-threaded leader across Data Science, Engineering, Commercial, Marketing, CRM, and Growth translating ML capability into customer-first experiences and aligning the organization around one decisioning strategy.

Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the customer prediction and decisioning portfolio across the full customer lifecycle evolving it from a measurement layer that predicts value into a decisioning engine that prescribes and orchestrates the actions that create it. Decide not just what action, but where and when.
Sense the opportunity and set direction: synthesize customer insight, commercial context, competitive signal, and ML advances into a clear, prioritized multi-quarter strategy then translate it into quarterly objectives the squad can execute.
Run a predict-and-optimize portfolio: partner with Data Science to advance our CLV, propensity, and uplift models extending prediction horizons beyond the near term, moving from cohort-level to customer-level granularity, and adding action-value attribution then pair them with budget/constraint optimization so we spend each marketing dollar where it returns the most. Ensure outputs are relevant, timely, and fair across segments.
Drive adoption of predictions as decisions: deepen how prediction outputs feed experimentation guardrails, CRM/communication decisioning, and growth & product strategy so models don't just inform analysis, they drive operational action.
Scale decisioning across all markets and touch points, ensuring consistent, explainable experiences customers understand and trust while navigating complex technical and operational trade-offs.
Define success metrics that balance customer and business outcomes satisfaction, retention, and engagement on one side; conversion, customer lifetime value, incremental lift, and ROI efficiency on the other and report directly on the outcomes that matter to both customers and the business.
Prioritize ruthlessly with rigorous product practices, balancing near-term efficiency wins against long-term strategic capabilities, and making clear pragmatic calls between ML, GenAI, heuristics, and simple rules based on ROI, latency, and maintainability.
Drive cross-functional alignment and adoption as a single-threaded leader across Tribes and Alliances influencing without authority to get Commercial, Marketing, CRM, and Growth to converge on, trust, and adopt a unified decisioning strategy.

Stakeholder influence & adoption You have a strong track record of influencing senior, cross-functional stakeholders often without direct authority and driving alignment toward clear decisions rather than just consensus. You’re able to translate complex algorithmic or technical concepts into simple, compelling business narratives for executives, and you stay resilient in large, fast-moving organizations where ambiguity is the norm.
End-to-end product craft You bring strong product leadership across the full lifecycle from opportunity identification to vision setting, strategy, execution, and prioritization under constraint. You typically have 6+ years of product management experience at Senior or Staff level, with a track record of shipping products that have had meaningful impact at scale across multiple markets.
Data-driven fundamentals You are highly data-native and comfortable defining success metrics, designing and interpreting A/B and incrementality experiments, and reasoning about causal impact rather than surface-level metrics. You’re comfortable working with data directly (including SQL where needed) and don’t rely solely on others to form insights or recommendations.
AI-native operator You actively use modern AI tools as part of your daily workflow for analysis, research, prototyping, and exploration. You’re able to form and test hypotheses faster by leveraging AI, increasing both your own velocity and that of the broader team.
What’s a strong advantage
ML fluency & science partnership You’re comfortable working closely with Data Science and ML Engineering teams, and can engage meaningfully in discussions around model performance, feature engineering, uplift/causal inference, and the ML lifecycle. Prior experience in personalization, recommendations, propensity models, or decisioning systems is a strong plus.
Commercial & subscription acumen You understand subscription-based business models and how pricing, promotions, and personalized offers influence LTV, retention, and churn. You can balance commercial outcomes with customer value in your decision-making.

About the opportunity
We are seeking a hands-on, strategic Senior Product Manager - Ops Automation & Enablement (OAE) with a passion for building the intelligence and systems behind world-class banking operations.
This is a true builder’s role: you will lead the strategy, design, delivery, and enterprise-scale adoption of Agentic AI, hyperautomation, process mining, and internal tooling to reshape how complex, control-intensive Banking Operations are executed.
You will work cross-functionally with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and operational leaders to ensure N26 can scale aggressively across markets and product offerings without proportional headcount growth—all while maintaining the strict regulatory and quality standards our customers expect.

s.h: Lead Enterprise Transformation & Agentic AI Adoption
s.t:
Architect AI Workflows: Design, deploy, and govern E2E, multi-step Agentic AI solutions and automations that target high-volume processes, cross-team friction, and manual back-office tasks.
AI Champion: Act as the primary AI Champion for Banking Operations: translating complex ML/AI concepts into practical, working systems rather than just talking about them.
Change Management & Value Realization: Identify structural and behavioral barriers to adoption; design frameworks that embed new AI capabilities into day-to-day operations and team decision-making.

Process Mining Re-Engineering: Lead structured process capture, process mining, and workflow mapping. Evaluate opportunities to completely redesign end-to-end workflows rather than merely automating existing inefficiencies.
Core CRM & Platform Integration: Partner with Conversational Banking and Platform owners to optimize Salesforce (our core case-management backbone) and integrate AI agents with our central architecture and AWS infrastructure.
Operational Efficiency & ROI: Define and track clear metrics for every initiative (FTE impact, handling times, error rates, cost-per-unit, and time saved) to ensure high business value and ROI.

Bridge Tech & Operations: Work directly with Banking Ops leads, Data Science, AI Enablement, and Engineering to turn operational pain points into clear product specs, PRDs, and prompt configurations.
Regulatory Excellence: Collaborate with Data Protection, Legal, and Compliance teams to build resilient workflows that comply strictly with GDPR, the EU AI Act, and internal governance standards.
Operational Readiness: Own product readiness for launches: ensuring changes in one pod do not disrupt downstream processes, control environments, or customer outcomes.

s.h: What you need to be successful
s.t:
Product Management Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, Process Engineering, or Operational Transformation, ideally in a fast-moving tech, digital, or fintech environment.
AI & Automation Track Record: Demonstrated experience taking ML, RPA, or Agentic AI products from 0 to 1 (or significantly scaling them) with measurable, quantified operational savings.
Hands-On & Technical Curiosity: Comfortable working with APIs, prompt engineering, agentic frameworks, and orchestration tools. You are hands-on enough to build/configure the first version yourself, but strategic enough to design the long-term vision.
Process Improvement Mindset: Proven expertise in workflow mapping, failure demand analysis, and structured waste-reduction methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent).
Regulated Environment Experience: Background in banking or fintech, navigating compliance, legal, and risk sign-offs in a control-heavy environment.
Analytical & Data-Driven: Proficient in using data to model impact before building and measure results after (Power BI, SQL, or similar).
Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of presenting complex trade-offs to senior leadership (EXCO/SteerCo) and influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority.

Structured by default: You write things down, build systems, and actively retire processes that no longer serve the organization.
AI-First Instinct: You inherently see how agents can augment human teams and make work faster, smarter, and cleaner.
Pragmatic & Outcome-Focused: You care deeply about results, operational quality, and scalable growth, not just deploying shiny tools.

Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

Luno has spent over a decade making digital assets safe to own. Since 2013, we've helped millions of people across more than 40 countries buy, store and invest in crypto, working with regulators in every market and holding all customer crypto 1:1. That discipline built the licences, banking relationships, custody and compliance machinery that the next era of this market will run on
The financial system is moving on-chain. Stablecoins are the only digital asset class operating at institutional scale today, and while 98% of supply is dollar-pegged, roughly half of global payment flows are not. That gap is the opportunity, and it is largest in exactly the markets Luno has spent twelve years building in.

You will join the Product Management team building Luno’s institutional business: the activation, digital asset account infrastructure and issuance products that let businesses, institutions and partners operate on the rails Luno has spent over a decade building. The portfolio spans Luno Institutional and BlockTower, the group’s stablecoin issuance business.

You will own how businesses and institutions get access to Luno, and to everything built on Luno’s rails. Whatever door a customer comes through, whether it’s institutional, a partner’s brand, or another business line in the group, your job is to make access fast, trusted and configurable.

You will run onboarding and verification as a single platform: one machine, configured per business line and per region, where each business line owns its own risk appetite and due diligence policy and you own everything that executes it.

You will sit with institutional customers to understand where onboarding loses them, work directly with verification vendors, and treat evolving regulators’ requirements as design inputs rather than blockers.

You’re joining the team that built and maintains Luno’s entire identity verification system across all markets for retail and institutional customers and will need to carefully balance how we build new features, while maintaining the integrity of our existing integrations and processes.

Own the business and institutional onboarding platform end-to-end: KYB, verification, screening, periodic refresh, and the journey from first application to first transaction
Configuration per business line: Luno Institutional and BlockTower each carry their own CDD standards and risk appetite, in segregated environments, on the platform you own
Measure time-to-onboard and abandonment: find where institutions drop out, discover why, and design the changes that fix it
Own the relationship with verification vendors: integration, performance, cost and our roadmap
Extend the platform to multi-region and global onboarding: working with legal, risk and country teams to turn a regulatory position into a compliant product
Partner with our operations teams: reduce manual effort per case, so specialists handle the complex work and automations handle the rest

You have 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager in a regulated fintech, crypto or financial services business
You have built products in onboarding, identity, KYC/KYB, compliance tooling or an adjacent domain
You are technically comfortable where product meets integration: vendor APIs, environment configuration, and how identity data moves between systems, in enough depth to make good trade-offs with engineers
You are rigorous with data: you can find where a journey leaks, quantify what it costs, and prioritise accordingly
You own delivery, not just definition: you work with engineering teams in a continuous rhythm and hold yourself accountable for what ships and what it achieves
You manage stakeholders as a craft: keeping operations, vendors and institutional customers aligned, communicating risks early, and garnering support through clear, concise writing
You work well with compliance, legal and risk teams, and you can hold a position on customer experience while respecting a regulatory obligation
You have managed third-party vendors as product dependencies: selection, integration and ongoing performance
You are comfortable in front of external stakeholders - institutional customers, vendors and partners - and can represent the product credibly to all of them
You use AI as part of how you work, in discovery, analysis, writing and prototyping, and you can show where it's changed your output , not just your tooling

About Watershed
Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.
We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

Product Managers at Watershed are the glue that unites engineering, design, climate science, and go‑to‑market under a single cohesive vision—and then ship it. This is a highly technical, hands‑on, and cross‑functional role: you will set direction for the Methodology team, which owns the standard methodologies, datasets, and developer tools that turn raw business data into auditable sustainability data.
No footprint is actually measured by counting atoms—every footprint relies on methodologies, emission factors, and reference datasets to translate activity data into emissions. Getting this right is what makes corporate sustainability reporting credible. Watershed centralizes that effort across hundreds of enterprises, and the Methodology team is the engine that keeps it accurate, current, and opinionated toward decarbonization.
You will partner with climate scientists, data engineers, verifiers, and standards bodies to decide what we build, why it matters, and how we deliver—with a relentless focus on scientific rigor, customer impact, and scale.
You will
Own the roadmap for Watershed’s corporate methodology: define the vision, strategy, and north‑star metrics for our data artifacts that constitute methodology (ingestion templates, activity types, external source databases, reporting queries etc)
Own verifier partnerships: source, negotiate, and manage relationships with third‑party verification and assurance providers, ensuring Watershed’s methodology earns external trust and meets evolving audit requirements.
Navigate the open‑data and standards ecosystem: build and maintain relationships with open‑dataset providers, standards‑setting bodies, and industry alliances; evaluate when to adopt, contribute to, or build alternatives.
Become an expert on the customer: sit with sustainability leads, data teams, and auditors to uncover pain points, validate hypotheses, and turn insights into product requirements.
Design for correctness and auditability: work with climate scientists and data engineers to ensure methodologies are accurate, transparent, and defensible under regulatory scrutiny.
Partner across the org: align roadmaps with Sales, Customer Success, Sustainability Advisors, Reporting, Supply Chain, and Finance teams so that methodology investments land successfully across every product surface.
Leverage AI to do all of the above
You might be a fit if you
Have 5+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, with a track record of shipping data products, datasets, or data platforms—ideally at high‑growth startups.
Have experience working with open datasets, open‑source projects, or industry data alliances—you understand the dynamics of adopting, contributing to, and building on shared data infrastructure.
Have managed external partnerships where you were the primary owner of the relationship, not just a stakeholder—bonus if those partnerships involved data providers, verifiers, auditors, or standards bodies.
Have built products for enterprise customers and can navigate compliance, change‑management, and the messy realities of data quality at scale.
Combine customer anthropology with data‑driven intuition: you can spend a day digging through emission factor databases or Python notebooks, then jump on a call to map a CSO’s reporting journey.
Thrive in ambiguity and love turning fuzzy, conflicting inputs—from regulators, scientists, customers, and verifiers—into a clear, inspiring product vision.
Communicate with precision: whether writing a methodology white paper, presenting a roadmap to leadership, or explaining a technical trade‑off to a customer, you articulate complex ideas simply and convincingly.

You have direct experience in climate, sustainability, or environmental science—whether through a prior role, academic background, or deep personal interest.
You’ve worked on products that involve regulatory or accounting standards and understand how standards shape product decisions.
Location
This role is based in San Francisco. We believe colocated time accelerates collaboration for platform‑level challenges.
If you’re eager to own the science and data that power climate action at scale, we’d love to meet you.
Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)
Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.
With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.
Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement.

We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

The LangSmith team owns and builds LangChain's core platform for observability, evaluation, and production reliability of AI systems. Drive Commercial Excellence: Formulate and execute a strategic vision that transforms risk mitigation into customer value. Treat these premium, paid capabilities like your own business, balancing pricing strategy, revenue drivers, and costs to ensure responsible growth.
Lead & Develop Senior Talent: Direct, coach, and elevate a team of high-performing product managers within Adyen’s Commercial Risk & Platform Fraud group.
Architect Smart Trade-offs: Simplify an ambiguous space by defining clear, actionable use cases with your engineering and partner teams. Strategically decide when to deploy automated technical solutions (such as AI/ML models) versus operational support to optimize merchant value.
Pragmatic Regulatory Strategy: Act as the ultimate product authority for Commercial Risk & Platform Fraud across Adyen. Accelerated Product Leader: You have 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of progression into leadership roles. You have launched and evolved complex products across every stage of the product lifecycle.

It is also one of the most complex experiences we build: a globally distributed, high-stakes flow that must feel effortless to the customer while satisfying rigorous risk, fraud, and regulatory requirements across every market we operate in.
We are looking for a Group Product Manager to own and scale Adyen’s end-to-end onboarding experience — spanning merchant and sub-merchant/platform onboarding worldwide. This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of front-end experience, growth, and regulated financial services.

You will own the customer-facing experience and the flows that drive activation, while partnering deeply with Risk, Fraud, Compliance, Legal, and Regulatory teams to ensure everything we ship is trusted, auditable, and acceptable to both our internal stakeholders and external governing bodies.

Own the Onboarding Experience: Set and execute the strategy for Adyen’s global onboarding surface. Own the front-end experience and API design, continuously optimize the flows that drive activation, conversion, and time-to-value across merchant and sub-merchant journeys.
Turn Onboarding into a Growth Engine: Treat onboarding as a primary lever for product-led growth. Use experimentation and data to remove friction, lift conversion, and accelerate how quickly customers reach value.
Balance Experience with Trust: Partner closely with Risk, Fraud, Compliance, Legal, and Regulatory teams to design onboarding experiences that are seamless for customers and fully acceptable to internal governance and external regulators. Make pragmatic, well-reasoned trade-offs between frictionless UX and rigorous control.
Apply AI to the Product and to How You Work: Bring AI and machine learning into the onboarding experience itself — smarter, faster, more adaptive flows — while operating as an AI-native leader who uses modern tooling to build products and raise the productivity of your team.
Build and Develop the Team: Lead, coach, and grow a globally distributed team of product managers across Chicago and Amsterdam. Set high standards for product craft, analytical rigor, and ownership.

Expand Beyond Payments: Extend testing capabilities so merchants can validate their full integration — not just payments, but across financial products, Uplift, Loyalty, and Giving.

Pioneer AI-Native Testing: Shape how AI agents and automated tools interact with our testing infrastructure. Ensure our platform is machine-readable and developer-tooling friendly, enabling the next generation of integration workflows.
Build the Full Testing Journey: Progressively deliver automated go-live validation, on-demand developer sandboxes, and workflow guidance that takes merchants from sign-up to production with minimal friction.

DevX Product Leadership: 8+ years of product experience, with significant time on platform or infrastructure products that serve both internal teams and/or external developers.
AI-Curious: You proactively discover and implement novel solutions leveraging Agentic AI. You challenge conventional limitations and extend your impact beyond the typical boundaries of product management.
Platform & API Thinking: Proven track record building developer tooling and/or API-first platforms at scale. You intuitively understand the tension between generic scalable solutions and purpose-built specific ones, and you know when to choose each.
Cross-Team Adoption & Stakeholder Management: Proven experience driving adoption of shared platforms across multiple product teams with competing roadmaps.
