Supabase is the open-source Postgres development platform that 7M+ developers and thousands of enterprises depend on every day. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

We’re looking for a Product Manager, Marketplace to join our Product Team to lead our marketplace and integration surfaces.
The marketplace is the two-sided surface of the Supabase ecosystem. On one side, Partners and developers build integrations on top of Supabase primitives like Auth, Storage, and Edge Functions, then publish them for the world to use. On the other, our developers come to discover new capabilities and wire them into their projects without leaving their workflow. Done well, it is the shortest path between a developer with a problem and the exact capability that solves it.
That surface is about to matter more than ever. As the number of capabilities explodes, and as agents begin to assemble software on a developer's behalf, the marketplace becomes the distribution and discovery layer for the whole ecosystem: how both developers and, increasingly, their agents find, trust, and compose what they need. This role owns it.

Own the product strategy and roadmap for the marketplace, the two-sided surface where Partners and developers publish integrations and where Supabase's developer customers discover and install them.
Make it effortless for a developer to find the right capability and integrate it. Own discovery, search, listings, and the whole path from install to working integration, so a new capability connects to Supabase primitives and runs inside a developer's project with minimal glue code.
Make publishing an integration fast and rewarding, so Partners and developers bring their best work to the marketplace and keep it current, and so the catalog stays deep where developers need it.
Set the quality bar and the listing standards, and build the review, guardrail, and versioning mechanisms, with Engineering and our Partnerships team, that keep the catalog trustworthy as it scales.
Own what a healthy marketplace looks like: define the metrics across both supply and demand, instrument the surface end to end, and let the signal rather than opinion drive what gets built next.
Position the marketplace as the distribution layer for agent-driven development, where capabilities get discovered and composed on a builder's behalf rather than browsed and installed by hand.

s.h: You might be a good fit if you
s.t:
Have 7+ years of product management on developer tools or marketplaces , or are an ex-founder with strong product instincts, and can identify which partners and integrations will matter most, with particular instinct for the agentic and code-first integrations now defining how developers build.
Have built and grown a two-sided surface: an app store, a plugin or integration ecosystem, a developer platform, or a marketplace, and understand the chicken-and-egg of balancing supply and demand, recruiting developers, driving listing quality, and making discovery and install effortless for the consuming side. Experience with app stores or developer-platform distribution is a strong plus.
Are biased toward speed , and would rather ship something imperfect and learn than spend another sprint polishing a spec.
Build with what you own, using the marketplace from both sides: publishing a test integration the way a Partner would, and sourcing and wiring one into a project the way a developer would. You form opinions through first-hand use.
Use AI tools to compress the slow parts of the job, like research, drafting, and synthesising feedback, so you spend more time on judgment calls.
Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote, so you make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings.

Fully Remote
We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
Tech Allowance
Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.
Annual Off-Sites
Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.
Flexible Work

The Ads Marketplace team is a strategic growth engine for Reddit Ads. Our mission is to democratize high-performance advertising by enabling brands to achieve world-class results with minimal friction. To achieve this, we need an incredibly robust, scalable, and state-of-the-art Machine Learning infrastructure.

The Ads ML Platform team is at the core of this mission, tasked with building the foundation that powers all of our content understanding, ad targeting, and ad ranking models. We are empowering our ML engineers and data scientists to move faster and build smarter.

As the Senior Product Manager for the Ads ML Platform, you will hold significant ownership over the infrastructure and tools that make our ads marketplace intelligent. You will define the vision and build the roadmap for a platform that enables unparalleled engineering velocity and supports the most modern ML architectures.
You will be the bridge between complex ML systems and business outcomes. Whether it's integrating generative AI to increase developer productivity, establishing unified model-serving infrastructure, or optimizing GPU utilization, your work will directly accelerate how quickly and effectively we can ship highly-performant ad products. If you are passionate about the intersection of platform engineering and state-of-the-art ML research, this is the role for you.

Define the Vision: Shape the long-term strategy and roadmap for Reddit’s Ads ML platform, ensuring we are adopting cutting-edge technologies (including Generative AI and LLM workflows) to stay ahead of the curve.
Accelerate Velocity: Build products and tooling that dramatically reduce friction for Machine Learning Engineers (MLEs) and Data Scientists, enabling them to train, deploy, and iterate on models faster than ever.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner deeply with Engineering, Data Science, and Ads Product teams to understand their constraints, prioritize platform initiatives, and deliver scalable infrastructure.
Drive Execution and Adoption: Own key performance indicators (KPIs) around platform reliability, latency, cost-efficiency, usage metrics, and developer productivity.
Stay Cutting-Edge: Keep your finger on the pulse of the broader ML ecosystem. Read the latest research papers, understand emerging architectures, and determine how they can be practically applied to Reddit’s Ads ML platform.
Distill pain points, translate to requirements : Conduct regular user research with MLEs in Ranking, Creative Effectiveness and Content Understanding to convert pain points (e.g., slow backfills, limited training speed, no way to quickly share features across models) into precise product requirements. Validate the needs and ensure they are tied into a broader vision for the org.

Experienced product manager with prior focus internal technical products, developer tools, data/ML platforms, and/or ads and content ranking.
Deeply analytical and highly technical background; you are comfortable working in complex data systems and understanding the entire machine learning lifecycle (training, inference, deployment, monitoring).
Genuine passion for machine learning and AI; you stay at the forefront of ML, enjoy reading ML research papers, stay informed on the latest industry trends, architectures, and capabilities.
Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to translate highly technical constraints (e.g., GPU scheduling, latency budgets) into actionable product roadmaps.
Strong communication skills; you can seamlessly translate technical requirements to business stakeholders and articulate business goals to engineering teams.

Prior professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, or Backend Software Engineer before transitioning into Product Management.
Understanding of the Ad Tech ecosystem (bidding, ranking, targeting).
Experience implementing or managing systems that support Generative AI/LLM workflows (Agentic automation, Prompt iteration, Fine-tuning, RAG).

You'll live in the data, work comfortably with analysis, design and read experiments, and move fast on a product where small changes compound across huge volume. The people who thrive here set their own direction and don't wait to be told what to work on. Analytical horsepower is the baseline. We also want you to bring, and keep building, a real user point of view.

A steady cadence of experiments: you define the hypotheses, get the instrumentation right, and interpret results with an eye on timing and release mechanics. The trade-offs between business outcomes and user experience on a high-volume product where both matter.

Clear, direct communication of what you're doing and why, to a demanding, fast-moving set of stakeholders. Coordination with Compliance, Legal, Operations, Credit, Design, and Support on product changes, including regulatory reviews, support escalation workflows, and operational readiness.

What the First 90 Days Look Like By day 30: A working command of the product, the data, and the funnel. You know how the surfaces you own perform, where the friction is, and where the biggest experiment opportunities sit. By day 60: Sharp hypotheses on your top opportunities, with the first experiments designed, instrumented, and in build.

By day 90: Experiments live and reading out, with a prioritized backlog and a clear point of view on what to double down on next. Why You're a Great Fit Strong analytical foundation. You're fluent in data, experienced with dashboards and SQL, and you understand A/B testing, experiment timing, and release mechanics in depth. Self-direction.

You take a loosely defined problem and drive it forward on your own initiative. People who need a fully scoped brief to get moving struggle here. A builder's background. You're clear, concise, and direct, and you can make your reasoning legible to a sharp audience. Drive and velocity. You move quickly and take real ownership of outcomes. Growing user instincts. You care about the user experience, not just the metric, and you want to sharpen that muscle. We'll support that growth.

Comfort operating in a regulated environment. You'll work closely with Legal, Compliance, Design, Credit and Support, seeking partnerships as part of the product process to deliver stronger outcomes. Consumer product experience is a plus. Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past.

The Role We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to own the logged-in customer experience at ZenBusiness — the first experience a new business owner sees after signing up and starting to run their company.

Work cross-functionally with design, engineering, and marketing to execute against that vision. Drive usage and attachment of our highest-value products Drive activation across our product suite by directly leading activation initiatives and equipping other PMs with the tools to drive activation themselves.

Prototype your high-potential ideas and put them in front of real customers or internal users for rapid feedback and iteration.

Proven track record owning mobile app products (iOS and/or Android) — you understand the platform, the patterns, and how to drive engagement on native surfaces. Demonstrated ability to design unified experiences across multiple products and partner closely with other PMs to make the whole greater than the sum of its parts.

Who is Credible ?
Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level.

On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score.

On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.
About the Role: Credible is looking for an AI-native Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our student loan lending marketplace, our flagship product. You will own and deliver features from ideation through launch, in close collaboration with design, engineering, and data.

Primarily, you'll focus on the front-end experience that helps students and parents discover and compare options across multiple lenders. This role requires AI fluency in both how you work and what you build.

In your workflow, you bring working concepts rather than documents describing them, using AI tools like Claude to prototype ideas, run your own analysis, and validate concepts before committing engineering resources. You bring the experience and rigor to know which few ideas are worth building, and the drive to see them through.

In the product itself, you will shape how Credible reaches users as loan discovery moves beyond the comparison page and into AI assistants and embedded experiences, and you will determine where AI belongs within our own funnel to make comparing and choosing a loan simpler.

Where AI touches the product, you own the quality bar: defining what good output looks like, measuring it, and ensuring it stays accurate and compliant. Teams will look to you and your product leadership to guide the product's vision and direction and to achieve team OKRs. Responsibilities:
Think Strategically and Creatively: Deliver new features for growing the student loan marketplace and align them with Credible 's long-term vision. Synthesize market trends, regulatory shifts in the student loan space, user needs, and rapidly advancing AI capabilities to continually reinvent the platform, including how it reaches users beyond our own site.
Own AI-Powered Product Surfaces: Shape how Credible helps students and parents discover and choose loans through AI assistants, embedded experiences, and AI-assisted flows within our own funnel. Decide where AI meaningfully improves the experience and where it doesn't belong.
Own the Roadmap: Manage roadmaps for both private student loans and student loan refinance products by identifying opportunities, weighing tradeoffs, and prioritizing team resources. Decide not only what to build, but what to remove when it isn't earning its place.
Prototype and Validate: Use AI tools like Claude to build working concepts, test them quickly, and validate ideas with real artifacts. Explore many approaches, and find the ones that resonate with users and lenders.
Make Data-Driven Decisions: Utilize data analysis, A/B testing, and user research to validate assumptions, uncover insights, and drive meaningful improvements to the business. Run your own queries and analysis rather than depending on others for every question.
Lead and Collaborate Across Functions: Proactively engage cross-functional teams to brainstorm innovative solutions and lead their implementation. Collaborate with engineering, design, data, partnerships, and operations teams to deliver product enhancements and achieve team OKRs.
Operate Responsibly in a Regulated Space: Student lending is compliance-constrained. Understand where AI-assisted work and AI-generated output need human review, where claims and disclosures matter, and how to move fast without creating regulatory or trust risk.

engineering teams without direct authority, and to balance competing requirements from

The Product Owner is responsible for the management and development of complex features on the Ryder corporate website.

This person would own the vision for their product and would use their written and oral communication and team building skills to successfully deliver features and socialize their product The ideal candidate has had history in ideating, creating and executing digital/software projects.

They have historically been the product owner on an Agile team and know the processes and ceremonies associated with SCRUM. This person has a history of creating the vision through "epics", "features" and "stories", can provide detailed acceptance criteria and works with the product team to ensure that each story meets the "definition of done."
· ACT AS THE PROXY FOR THE CUSTOMER: Should advocate for the customer and make sure that their target market is being heard. This person should have an uncanny ability to put themselves in their customer's shoes.
· BE GREAT AT COMMUNICATING: Able to communicate clearly and effectively to leadership, stakeholders and technical resources alike. The Product Owner needs to assert their opinion and be involved while allowing others to actively contribute to ultimately create a better product. This person must exude transparency and communicate regularly from the top to the bottom of the organization.
· BE PASSIONATE ABOUT THEIR PRODUCT: Interested in other technology, constantly challenging themselves to do better and drawing on inspiration from other products. They believe in what they do so much, that others jump on the proverbial "bandwagon" to help make their product a success.
· FOCUSED ON DATA: Know how to get and use data to create a better product. Data can also be used in helping to justify features and functionality developed in their product.
· BUSINESS ORIENTED: Able to make a link between what users do and how the company makes money.
· DETAIL AND STRATEGY: Should set the vision of the product but also be able to deal with the detail of a working backlog whilst setting direction using a strategic road map.
Essential Functions
Develop, Launch & Support New Features On The Ryder Corporate Website. The Product Owner will help orchestrate the launch of features or capabilities for Ryder’s business units. They will help the Product team collaborate across functions and business units to successfully grow revenues and deliver value to both users and customers alike.
Wide Knowledge of Ryder Users and Customers. The Product Owner will be expected to become a subject matter specialist on the customer and user: their issues, pains, desires, how they think, how they work, and how they decide to interact with Ryder products. They will translate these needs into epics, features, user stories, and ultimately product deliverables to ensure a positive customer & user-centric experience.
Broad Knowledge of Data. The Product Owner will be expected to work with data analysts to produce meaningful insights about their product, customers, and supported business units.
Driving AI Innovation at Ryder. The Product Owner will be expected to drive AI innovation and adoption at Ryder through their product and product team.
Skill And Abilities
Ability to lead Design Thinking activities to identify opportunities and define product strategies, including conducting competitive market analysis, customer research, capability and dependency analysis, defining objectives, and outlining key results.
Ability to evaluate, prioritize, and determine what product experiences should be built, identifying the core user stories that will deliver optimal value, and establish a shared understanding for all stakeholders involved.
Ability to partner with product design colleagues to design impactful user experiences based on the target user stories, features, and specifications, while leveraging interactive prototypes and lean practices.
Ability to partner with data colleagues to identify the role that data and intelligence play in the digital product, defining tactical and strategic opportunities to build into a product roadmap.
Ability to partner with technology teams to identify the platform and cloud capabilities required to support product innovation, working closely with technology throughout the build, test, and release of the product.
Ability to tell compelling stories that deliver insights about people and behavior both verbally and visually, in a way that generates empathy, emotion, and engagement.

You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.

As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools.

You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams.

Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.

· Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.

· Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.

· Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.

· Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on.

· Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.

· Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.

· Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.

· A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.

· Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.

· The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.

· Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.

· A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.

· An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.

· A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.

What you’ll need

· Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.

· The proven ability to translate intricate developer workflows into clear product roadmaps.

· Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.

· A deep understanding of version control mechanics, code-change workflows, and how developers actually ship code.

· Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.

· As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted setups.

What success looks like

Success means moving VCS from a platform subsystem to a clear, strategic ecosystem. You’ll have built a compelling product vision that engineering teams are aligned on and customers are excited about. You won’t just be copying what exists.

You’ll be finding entirely new ways to solve code-change workflows, especially as AI becomes a bigger part of development. Ultimately, you’ll earn your team's trust by making sound decisions, keeping projects moving, and leaving the product better than you found it.

Ein erster Einblick: Wir, die MIFCOM GmbH, bieten die besten Jobs in der Gaming-Branche. Als einer der führenden Hersteller persönlich konfigurierbarer PCs und Notebooks für Gamer und anspruchsvolle Nutzer sind wir immer auf der Suche nach neuen Talenten, mit einem Faible für Technik, die gemeinsam mit uns ihren nächsten Karriereschritt machen wollen.
Mit über 180 engagierten Mitarbeitern fertigen wir an 2 Standorten PCs, Workstations und Server nach Kundenwunsch. Egal ob Business-Laptop oder High-End Gaming PC, wir setzen alles daran die Vorstellungen unserer Kunden umzusetzen – „Geht nicht, gibt’s nicht!“
Dabei sind ein Höchstmaß an Flexibilität, bedingungslose Kundenorientierung und eine ausgesprochene Hands-On Mentalität die Grundpfeiler unserer täglichen Arbeit. Vielfach von der Fachpresse ausgezeichnet und mit besten Kundenbewertungen sind wir der führende PC-Systembuilder in Deutschland.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Produktmanagement-Teams suchen wir aktuell einen Produktmanager – PC-Komponenten & Systemkonfiguration (m/w/d) . In dieser Rolle bringst Du ein breites Verständnis für PC-Konfigurationen und Komponentenökosysteme mit und entwickelst diesen Bereich innerhalb unseres Produktmanagements aktiv weiter. Du bist der Spezialist für das Zusammenspiel der Teile – mit einem Schwerpunkt auf Kühlung, Lüfter und Gehäuse, aber nie ohne den Blick aufs Gesamtsystem.
Deine Aufgaben: Als Produktmanager – PC-Komponenten & Systemkonfiguration (m/w/d) verantwortest Du Sortiment, Prozesse und Lieferantenbeziehungen in Deinen Warengruppen und bringst gleichzeitig Dein Systemverständnis ein, um unser Konfigurationsangebot kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
Der Schwerpunkt liegt im Produktmanagement – ergänzt um einkaufsnahe Aufgaben wie Verhandlungen und Konditionsgestaltung.
Deine täglichen To-Dos umfassen vor allem die folgenden Tätigkeiten:
Du übernimmst die Sortimentsstrategie für PC-Komponenten mit einem Schwerpunkt auf Kühler, Lüfter und Gehäuse – von der Produktauswahl und technischen Validierung über Kompatibilitätsprüfungen bis hin zur Weiterentwicklung des Gesamtportfolios
Du bringst ein ganzheitliches Verständnis für PC-Konfigurationen mit; Du denkst nicht in einzelnen Bauteilen, sondern erkennst, wie Komponenten im System zusammenwirken und nutzt dieses Wissen, um unser Konfigurationsangebot gezielt weiterzuentwickeln
Du übernimmst das Vendor Management für Deine Warengruppen und bist interner Hauptansprechpartner für Hersteller und Distributoren in allen technischen und kommerziellen Fragestellungen
Du führst Lieferantenverhandlungen zu Einkaufskonditionen, Rahmenverträgen, Rabattstaffeln und Sonderaktionen und optimierst so kontinuierlich unsere Marge und Verfügbarkeit
Du bewertest neue Produkte technisch fundiert hinsichtlich Kompatibilität, Leistung und Verarbeitungsqualität – bei Lüftern und Kühlern spielen dabei auch Design und Ästhetik eine wichtige Rolle: Formgebung, Beleuchtungskonzepte und aktuelle Optik-Trends beeinflussen die Kaufentscheidung unserer Kunden
Du behältst Markt-, Trend- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen im Blick und leitest daraus Sortiments- und Preisentscheidungen ab
Du pflegst und verwaltest die Artikel Deiner Warengruppen inklusive technischer Detaildaten in unserem Warenwirtschaftssystem und Onlineshop
Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktmanagement-Prozesse aktiv voran – von Forecasting und Reporting bis zur abteilungsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit mit Einkauf, Produktion und Service
Du stehst im engen Austausch mit anderen Teams aus den Bereichen Einkauf, Produktion und Service, um Sortiments- und Verfügbarkeitsthemen frühzeitig zu klären

Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a Civil Industrial, Ingeniero/a en Informática o carrera afín, con experiencia implementando soluciones tecnológicas y productos digitales en el segmento financiero. En TCIT valoramos a profesionales que puedan liderar el “puente” entre negocio y tecnología: traducir necesidades, ordenar el trabajo del equipo y sostener el foco en el resultado.
Requisitos y experiencia
Formación: Ingeniería Industrial, Informática y/o Civil.
Experiencia implementando soluciones tecnológicas y productos digitales en el sector financiero.
Dominio de metodologías ágiles para la gestión de productos y la coordinación con equipos.
Habilidades de comunicación para alinear requerimientos con heads de negocio y stakeholders.
Experiencia en empresas de Banca y/o Fintech.
Manejo de Inglés B1-B2
Competencias y habilidades personales
Orientación a resultados y capacidad para priorizar según valor de negocio.
Pensamiento analítico: ordenar información, gestionar dependencias y detectar riesgos.
Alta coordinación y seguimiento: sostener el backlog, la planificación y la entrega incremental.
Comunicación clara y proactiva, adaptando el lenguaje entre negocio y tecnología.
Colaboración: trabajo efectivo con proveedores, equipos de desarrollo y áreas internas.
Si te entusiasma liderar productos digitales con enfoque en calidad y sostenibilidad, y disfrutas trabajar con equipos ágiles en entornos Cloud, este desafío es para ti.
Nuestra misión es asegurar que las soluciones digitales evolucionen de forma ordenada, medible y alineada al negocio. Tu foco será convertir necesidades y oportunidades en un backlog claro y accionable, liderando la planificación y el seguimiento del producto durante todo su ciclo de vida.

Liderar el ciclo de vida de las soluciones digitales: discovery, definición, planificación, entrega y mejora continua.
Transformar iniciativas de negocio en un backlog claro, priorizado y mantenido (con criterios de valor, alcance y dependencias).
Gestionar el presupuesto del producto/solución, coordinando costos, recursos y planificación con las áreas correspondientes.
Coordinar con proveedores, equipos de desarrollo y stakeholders para asegurar ejecución efectiva y alineamiento.
Definir y hacer seguimiento de objetivos del producto, métricas y resultados esperados, para una gestión basada en datos.
Dominar metodologías ágiles (por ejemplo, Scrum/Kanban) y asegurar prácticas saludables de trabajo con los equipos.
Trabajar con tecnologías Cloud en AWS (u otras), comprendiendo el impacto de decisiones de arquitectura en el producto.
Alinear requerimientos con los heads de negocio, asegurando claridad, trazabilidad y acuerdos sobre alcance.
En este rol, buscamos que aportes criterio para equilibrar valor, esfuerzo y riesgo, manteniendo una comunicación fluida entre negocio, tecnología y terceros.

About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia.

As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal.

The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved. What you'll be doing
Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.
Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.
Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.
Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.
Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.
Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.
Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.
What you'll need
Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.
Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.
Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).
AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.
Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.
Outcomes
Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap
Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch
Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds
AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted
Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged
Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Philippines . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Philippines . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1.

Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Originally posted on Himalayas

The Role We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app. This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release. What You'll Own
Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.
Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.
Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.
Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.
Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.
Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.
Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.
Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.
Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.
Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.
Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.
High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.
Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.
The Kind of Builder We Want
Starts from user problems, not feature lists.
Can make decisions with incomplete information.
Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.
Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.
Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.
This Role Is Not For
People who only write decks and do not drive execution.
PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.
Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

Location Our Technical Product Owner - DoiT Cloud Intelligence - Core Services will be an integral part of our global Product team. This role is based remotely in the East Coast US, the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel.

Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multi-cloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more.

An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity We’re hiring a Technical Product Owner to drive rapid delivery and iteration for the Core Services team of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, our platform that helps DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, and FinOps teams manage public cloud environments effectively and efficiently.

Core Services builds and operates foundational platform capabilities used across DoiT’s products and engineering teams. Its responsibilities include identity and access management, authentication and authorization, customer and tenant services, shared APIs, platform integrations, and other cross-cutting capabilities.

This role is designed for someone with a technical product mindset who is comfortable working deep within platform architecture, distributed systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and internal engineering workflows.

You will help turn broad platform needs into clear technical product direction, sequenced investments, and reliably delivered capabilities. You will report to a VP of Product and work as an embedded member of the Core Services Engineering team.

You will collaborate closely with engineering leadership, architects, security, product teams, and internal platform consumers to determine what the team should build next and why. Role clarity: VP of Product vs. Technical Product Owner VP of Product (what they own)
Sets the overall vision, strategy, positioning, and long-range roadmap for the platform area.
Makes the highest-level prioritization calls across multiple components and investment themes.
Aligns stakeholders across the company (executive leadership, GTM, partners) on direction and tradeoffs.
Defines success at the portfolio/area level and ensures the area’s outcomes ladder up to company goals.
Technical Product Owner (what you own)
Owns delivery, iteration, and learning velocity for the Core Services.
Turns VP-level direction into clear problems to solve, a prioritized backlog, and incrementally shippable scope.
Runs the feedback loop: discover → define → build → release → measure → iterate, repeatedly.
Works within the Engineering teams to ensure they are always building the highest-value next increment with clarity, quality
Review technical designs, reason about tradeoffs and constraints, and understand their impact on delivery timelines and system behavior, without being the primary implementer
Leverages deep, hands-on DevOps experience and public cloud understanding to ensure that solution implementations are done correctly
This distinction matters: the VP creates the “why” and “where”; the Product Owner ensures the “what next” is always sharp, validated, and shipping. Responsibilities Fast iteration and backlog leadership
Translate the VP’s strategy into a sequenced backlog of problems, user stories, and acceptance criteria that the Engineering team can deliver continuously.
Keep work “thin-sliced” so the team can ship frequently, learn quickly, and reduce risk through iteration.
Maintain a disciplined cadence of backlog refinement, sprint readiness, and scope negotiation to keep delivery predictable without slowing innovation.
Deep user and workflow understanding
Leverage your hands-on DevOps experience and expertise in the real-world workflows of the professionals you’re building for - especially cloud operators and practitioners.
Use firsthand domain knowledge and ongoing customer conversations to identify friction, gaps, and opportunities for differentiation.
Prioritize enhancements that materially improve outcomes: speed, reliability, clarity, safety, governance, cost impact, or operational simplicity.
Customer validation and external communication
Often speak with customers (aiming for 3-5 calls a week) and cross-functional DoiT stakeholders regularly to test ideas, validate assumptions, and pressure-test tradeoffs.
Communicate clearly and confidently: share concepts early, take feedback openly, synthesize input into decisions, and explain “why” in a way that builds trust.
Rely on your hands-on, DevOps experience to go deep with stakeholders (internal/external) into the technical details of the problem, our solution, and the contexts and environments in which both of these exist.
Support beta/design-partner motions where appropriate by shaping hypotheses, success criteria, and rollout plans.
Engineering-embedded technical product ownership
Operate as a core member of the Core Services’ Engineering team - present in daily collaboration, crisp in decision-making, and pragmatic about constraints.

We are seeking a highly experienced and technically proficient Billing and Revenue Systems IT Product Manager to drive the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of our critical billing, revenue recognition, and order-to-revenue (O2R) systems.

The ideal candidate brings 5–8 years of dedicated O2R experience, with deep hands-on expertise in Zuora Billing and Zuora Revenue (RevPro), and a strong foundation in finance and subscription revenue operations.

This role requires a candidate who understands the business impact behind every system decision — someone who can speak fluently in ARR, deferred revenue, and ASC 606 as comfortably as they navigate Zuora data models and API integrations.
This position demands a unique blend of product management acumen, financial domain expertise, technical depth, and the ability to bridge Finance, IT, and Engineering teams. You will also serve as an early adopter and champion of AI-powered tools and automation to continuously improve the efficiency and intelligence of billing and revenue operations. You will partner closely with a Zuora Administrator who handles day-to-day operational work and support.

Business Solutioning: Proactively identify and solve complex business challenges through benchmarking, competitive research, and stakeholder engagement across Finance, Sales, and Operations. Translate financial KPIs — including ARR, MRR, NRR, churn, and deferred revenue — into system requirements and deliver best-in-class solutions that incorporate emerging trends in subscription management and revenue recognition (ASC 606/IFRS 15).
Requirements Translation & Execution: Transform high-level business and finance objectives into clear, actionable system requirements that guide design and implementation phases with precision. Ensure requirements account for revenue accounting impact, financial close timelines, and audit readiness.
Zuora Subject Matter Expert (SME): Serve as the organization's primary authority on Zuora Billing and Zuora Revenue (RevPro) — including product architecture, data models, custom objects, workflow configurations, rule sets, and integration points within the broader O2R ecosystem (Salesforce CPQ, NetSuite ERP). Stay current on Zuora roadmap releases and proactively assess impact to existing configurations.
Finance & Revenue Operations Partnership: Act as the key systems partner to Finance, Revenue Accounting, and Revenue Operations teams. Develop deep understanding of how billing system configurations drive financial outcomes, including revenue recognition schedules, contract modifications, standalone selling prices (SSPs), and period-end close processes.
System Design & Scalability: Partner with engineering and technical architects to ensure system designs are scalable, maintainable, and compliant with security and regulatory standards. Architect solutions that support business growth, new pricing models, and evolving revenue recognition requirements.
AI-Driven Process Innovation: Identify and champion opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation to streamline billing operations, reduce manual effort, and workflow automation. Use generative AI tools to accelerate requirements documentation, testing, and knowledge management.
Agile Development Leadership: Lead agile delivery (Scrum/Kanban), including backlog prioritization, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives to drive continuous improvement and velocity.
System Deployment & Quality Assurance: Oversee configuration changes, manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and ensure successful deployment of new features across Zuora Billing and Zuora Revenue platforms. Define and maintain test scripts that validate financial accuracy and compliance.
Change Management & User Adoption: Lead change management initiatives — including developing training materials, conducting user training sessions, and driving adoption of new features and processes. Communicate the 'why' behind system changes to Finance and Operations stakeholders to ensure buy-in and smooth transitions.
SOX Compliance & Controls: Maintain and document SOX controls for billing and revenue systems, ensuring adherence to internal control frameworks and supporting audit requirements. Partner with Internal Audit to address control gaps and maintain a robust compliance posture.
Vendor Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with Zuora and other key vendors, serving as the primary point of contact to influence product roadmaps, escalate issues, and leverage vendor expertise to drive business value.
Risk & Delivery Management: Proactively manage project risks, resolve emerging issues, and ensure timely, high-quality delivery of all O2R initiatives.
Priority Management & Stakeholder Relations: Effectively manage competing priorities by assessing urgency and business impact, making informed trade-off decisions, and maintaining strong stakeholder relationships through transparent communication and expectation management.
User-Centric System Design: Maintain a customer service-oriented mindset, keeping end users at the forefront of system design while balancing business requirements and technical constraints to deliver intuitive, efficient solutions.

Experience: 5–8 years in IT product management, systems analysis, or similar roles focused on financial/billing systems within a SaaS or subscription business environment.
Zuora Expertise (Mandatory): Deep, hands-on experience configuring and implementing Zuora Billing and Zuora Revenue (RevPro), including subscription products, rate plans, discount schedules, billing rules, revenue recognition rules, performance obligations, and custom objects. Proven ability to architect end-to-end billing and revenue solutions, not just administer them.
Finance & Revenue Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of SaaS subscription financial models and revenue metrics including ARR, MRR, NRR, churn, and gross retention. Deep knowledge of revenue recognition under ASC 606/IFRS 15, including contract modifications, variable consideration, standalone selling prices (SSPs), and deferred/unbilled revenue accounting. Ability to partner effectively with Revenue Accounting, FP&A, and RevOps teams.

Liberis is in the middle of a meaningful shift. We started as a single-product business and are quickly becoming a truly multi-product embedded finance company, with different funding structures, revenue models and customer relationships sitting alongside each other in the same portfolio. That complexity creates real demand for better data, better insight and clearer thinking about how all of it fits together - with this role sitting at the centre of that challange!

As our Senior Data Product Manager, you’ll sit right at the intersection of product, analytics, engineering and senior leadership, helping define the data products that power smarter decisions across Liberis.

You’ll have real ownership over roadmap, prioritisation and ways of working, and your work will directly influence how teams access, understand and use data day to day. This role is a high-impact opportunity for someone who wants to shape how a business uses data at scale!

You’ll be joining a team with a broad remit and a genuine mandate to improve the data experience across the company, so there’s a lot of scope to make the role your own and shape the future of the domain.

You will own the data and insights product for Liberis, building the foundations that let our commercial, credit and operations teams actually understand the business they're running.

That means, thinking carefully about the entities in our data model, how products and customers relate to each other, how those relationships surface in reporting and analysis - and how it eventually all comes out in great dashboards, tools and self-serve capabilities.

This is about shipping products which are genuinely useful, not just technically correct.

Our Engineering Team is going through an AI-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. Data, insights and analytics are a crucial part of that journey and you will be a key player in leading, innovating and rapidly improving our posture and capabilities at the intersection of data and AI.

If you like solving genuinely hard problems, bringing clarity to complex environments and building products that have visible business impact - this is the role for you!

Your primary job is to help Liberis's commercial decision makers understand the small businesses we serve and how they consider, use and perform across our product range. Doing this well requires a clear conceptual model of the business and a willingness to engage with stakeholders across the business, as well as taste and customer empathy in developing a great insights product including dashboards, insight tools and self-serve capabilities.

You will own the roadmap for our internal data & insight products. Working with stakeholders across commercial, credit, finance and operations, you will define what good looks like and then work with your team to build it. You will run prioritisation, manage the backlog and make decisions about where effort goes.

You will also spend a meaningful amount of time in the detail, reviewing data models and dashboards, asking hard questions about definitions, and making sure what we ship is accurate and trusted.

You will partner closely with the engineering side of your team on how data is modelled and structured in BigQuery and DBT, and with analysts on how it gets presented in Looker. You don't need to write production code, but you need enough technical understanding to be a genuine partner in those conversations. You will also be responsible for continuing to expand our partner-facing reporting, whereby partners gain visibility into their portfolio.

This role requires someone who can think clearly about complex data structures and translate that thinking into products that non-technical people actually find useful. The ideal person has strong conceptual thinking skills, great product instincts and enough technical depth to earn the trust of the engineers and analysts they work with.

· Proven experience in a senior data product or analytics product role in a business with real complexity

· A track record of helping commercial teams make better decisions through better data, not just shipping dashboards

· Strong ability to think about entities, taxonomies and relationships in data

· Hands-on experience with Looker and LookML and familiarity with best practices and scalable approaches to these systems

· Working knowledge of SQL, DBT and BigQuery, enough to engage seriously with how data is modelled and what's feasible, and to express your thinking in code-speak where needed

· Experience working with a multi skilled team of analysts and data engineers

· Clear, confident communication with senior commercial stakeholders

Next steps If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on

Our hybrid approach

Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working policy requires team members to be in the office at least 3 days a week, but ideally 4 days. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

About ScholarshipOwl
ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S., connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.
We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager to take full ownership of the conversion engine at ScholarshipOwl, from the first visitor touchpoint through to a paid subscription. This is a high-impact, high-velocity role for someone who lives in the data, thrives on experimentation, and values action over perfection.
You will be the architect of our growth. You’ll spend your days identifying leaks in the funnel, hypothesizing solutions, and working alongside a dedicated pod of engineers and designers to ship experiments that move the needle on revenue and retention. If you are a "full-stack" growth thinker who can move from a Mixpanel cohort analysis to a detailed technical spec this is the role for you.

Own the Conversion Engine: Take end-to-end responsibility for the user journey, optimizing every step from landing page registration to paywall conversion and subscription retention.
Drive the Experiment Roadmap: Build, prioritize, and maintain a high-tempo experimentation backlog. You will use frameworks (like ICE or RICE) to ensure we are always working on the highest-leverage growth bets.
Analyze & Diagnose: Monitor funnel and retention metrics daily in Mixpanel. You’ll identify exactly where users are dropping off and perform deep-dive discovery to understand the why .
Ship with Velocity: Write precise product specs and acceptance criteria that allow engineering and design to execute independently. We prioritize shipping "good enough" tests today to get data, rather than waiting for "perfect" features next month.
Optimize Revenue Levers: Design and run pricing, paywall, and offer optimization tests. You’ll also evaluate new growth levers like organic loops, landing page personalization, and winback programs.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Lead a dedicated pod of engineers and designers, maintaining strong working relationships with our dashboard and B2B teams to drive unified sprint priorities.
Continuous Discovery: Conduct meaningful customer discovery interviews with our Gen-Z audience to uncover behavioral insights that data alone can’t show.

4+ years of Product Management experience , specifically in a **Growth-**focused role.
Experimentation Mastery: Proven track record of designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests that resulted in measurable improvements to business KPIs (CVR, ARPU, Churn).
Data Fluency: You are a power user of product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar). You don't wait for a data analyst; you find the answers yourself.
SaaS/Subscription Expertise: You understand the nuances of subscription models—trial-to-paid transitions, renewal cycles, and friction-point reduction.
Technical Precision: Ability to write clear, "dev-ready" product specs and acceptance criteria. You understand technical trade-offs and how to scope an MVP.
Mentoring & Leadership: A mentoring and knowledge-sharing mindset with a desire to level up the broader team on growth methodologies and experimentation rigor.
Gen-Z Empathy: You have an intuition for (or experience with) B2C products targeting younger audiences and understand their unique digital behaviors.
Growth Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast-moving environments, and the fact that 70% of experiments might fail—as long as we learn from them.

Experience with payment platforms (Stripe, Braintree) or Figma/prototyping tools.
Knowledge of lifecycle/email marketing , SEO , and paid acquisition channels.
Growth-focused certifications (e.g., Reforge).
Background in EdTech or student-facing products.

Fully Remote – Work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.

Unlimited PTO – We value results over hours worked and trust you to manage your time.

Semarchy has grown into an industry leader in the data management space. We're searching for a Product Manager to help expand the Semarchy Data Platform (SDP) and support our development teams. As a Product Manager, you are one of our core creative talents.

Reporting to the Head of Product Management and working closely with engineering, design, and the field, you will turn customer problems and market evidence into product capabilities that customers value — and pay for. Your goal will be to increase the adoption and market fit of the Semarchy Data Platform.

You will own your product scope end-to-end: discovering what customers actually need, framing the problems worth solving, prioritizing ruthlessly, shaping the roadmap, and partnering across teams to bring capabilities to market successfully.

Your early focus is likely to involve Semarchy 's AI-oriented capabilities — such as agentic access to governed Data Products and AI-assisted stewardship — so experience or genuine enthusiasm in this area is a real advantage.

As with any growing product organization, scope and responsibilities will be shaped together and are expected to evolve over time. We are therefore looking for someone adaptable and curious, who thrives when the problem space is still taking shape. Responsibilities
Discovery & customer research: Run structured problem discovery — investigate problem spaces, validate pain intensity and business impact, map current alternatives, and confirm willingness to change. Engage continuously with customers and partners, including active participation in design partner programs.
Focus on customer value: Anchor every decision in customer outcomes rather than mechanisms. Be able to articulate the customer, the problem, and why it matters — and bring that evidence into product decisions.
Roadmapping & prioritization: Own and maintain the roadmap for your area with regular reviews, clear milestones, and transparent change rationale. Prioritize using evidence rather than assumption, make deliberate trade-offs, and contribute to a monthly-updated, prioritized roadmap that reflects what the market actually needs.
Delivery: Partner closely with engineering and design through the full product delivery lifecycle, from discovery to release. Produce specifications and UI concepts, and refine and organize the product backlog — shaping the end-to-end experience, not just features.
Commercialization & field enablement: Play a key role in the commercialization process, coordinating the activities within your scope — such as internal training, previews, enablement, and messaging — so releases reach customers fully field-ready. Contribute captivating documentation and customer-facing assets (blogs, whitepapers, solution briefs) that help the field and marketing communicate value, and participate in commercialization retrospectives.
AI-oriented capabilities (initial focus): Shape how customers connect their enterprise AI ecosystem to governed, trusted data (e.g., agentic / MCP-based access). Explore and validate AI-assisted stewardship and governed AI participation, and help translate fast-moving AI research and prototypes into shippable, differentiated value.
Evangelism: Champion Semarchy products to internal and external audiences — talking to customers, partners, industry analysts, and field personnel — and feed their input back into product strategy and prioritization.

Proven experience as a product manager or product owner in the B2B, SaaS, or technology space, with a solid portfolio.
Demonstrated strength in customer discovery and research — you have talked to many customers and turned what you heard into product decisions.
A clear bias toward value and outcomes — comfortable challenging requests and reframing them around the underlying problem.
Strong prioritization and roadmapping discipline, with the ability to communicate decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Solid experience in product ownership, including backlog management, requirements gathering, and specification production.
Technical ability to interact with expert developers on topics such as software architecture, databases, APIs, and user interfaces.
Proven ability to quickly learn and understand market topics and technical concepts.
Working knowledge of modern AI architectures and integration patterns (e.g., LLMs, RAG, MCP, vector databases, agents, and AI APIs), with the ability to translate emerging capabilities into enterprise product strategy and requirements.
Comfort operating with evolving scope and ambiguity — you thrive when the problem space is still taking shape.
Fluent in English and French; communication skills to collaborate, present, and evangelize the Semarchy vision and products.
Ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously while remaining flexible and consistently hitting deadlines.
Strong Plus
Experience or strong interest in enriching B2B products with AI / GenAI capabilities and integrating with AI ecosystems.
Experience or knowledge of data technologies (structured and unstructured), enterprise applications (ERP, CRM, etc.), and cloud infrastructures (AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker).
Previous experience with data governance, catalog, integration, and/or MDM products and solutions.
Familiarity with commercialization / go-to-market processes and field enablement.

Oula delivers maternity care built around our patients—offering comprehensive support before, during, and after pregnancy. With fewer C-sections and higher VBAC success rates, our research-backed approach is delivering better outcomes. Our team of trusted midwives, OBGYNs, and dedicated care navigators ensure our patients get the type of care they need in the moments that matter most.
Since launching in 2021, we’ve expanded to include Preconception and Miscarriage Care, Pregnancy Care, Postpartum Support, and Gynecology. We currently have 4 clinics in the tri-state area, with three new clinics opening in 2026! Come join our team of clinicians, innovators, operators, and technologists passionate about setting a new standard in maternity care.

Product Manager
Full-Time
New York, Chicago or Charlotte
Reports to VP, Central Operations
About Oula
Oula Health is a venture-backed, midwifery-led maternity and GYN care company building the next generation of women's healthcare. We partner exclusively with major health systems — including Mount Sinai, Stamford Health, and Novant Health — to embed our collaborative OB-GYN and midwifery model directly inside their networks. We're a team of ~100 people at Series B stage, with 4 clinics today and three more opening in 2026.

At Oula, our product doesn't sit alongside our EHR — it integrates directly into it. Every product and engineering decision has downstream consequences for how our EHRs are configured, and every EHR configuration decision shapes what's possible on the product side. Someone has to hold both at once.
We're looking for a technically-minded Product Manager to own and evolve our core technology stack — including our EHR, patient portal, and care management platform. This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and health system integration, serving as the internal and external subject matter expert on our EMR and the primary lead for health system EHR integrations.
You'll manage the day-to-day health of our tech stack, partnering closely with both internal teams and external health system stakeholders to ensure our systems run smoothly and our integrations deliver.

You can sit with a midwife and understand why a clinical template matters, then turn around and write a bug ticket that engineering can actually action, then build the SOP so the next market launch doesn't require you to be in the room. When things are ambiguous (and they often are), you'll lean in rather than wait for clarity.
What You'll Own
EHR Configuration & Clinical Systems
Own day-to-day management of our core tech stack: the EHR, patient portal, and care management platform
Own Athena and Epic configuration end to end: clinical templates, order sets, lab configurations, payer connectivity, and access management for clinical and ops staff
Lead EHR integration efforts as the internal and external subject matter expert — FHIR/HL7 data exchange, health system IT coordination and committed go-live timelines
Own and accelerate Epic integration timelines as we onboard additional health system partners
Maintain configuration integrity as new markets launch and care model workflows evolve
Partner with our IT team on infrastructure; own the clinical systems layer they don't touch
Product Operations & Launch
Own bug intake and prioritization from Market Operations — standardize how Engineering receives, scopes, and resolves issues and communicates status back to the field
Build structured launch toolkits and training materials so clinic teams are prepared for new feature rollouts on day one
Coordinate end-to-end launches across Product, Engineering, and Operations
Identify where AI and automation can reduce manual administrative burden in product operations workflows
Standards & Knowledge Management
Build and maintain the clinical systems SOP library so new market setup is repeatable — documented well enough that a new hire can execute without you in the room
Develop onboarding materials for clinic managers and clinical staff on EHR workflows and tooling
Drive feature parity efforts so patients and clinicians experience a consistent standard of care across markets
Data & Reporting
Build and maintain dashboards tracking feature adoption, issue resolution, and rollout health across clinics
Develop quarterly reporting for Product, leadership, and health system partners on platform performance
Ensure data infrastructure is in place to measure the impact of every feature rollout

3+ years with product operations, technical program management, or PM-adjacent work — ideally at a growth-stage digital health or services company
Strong problem-solving instincts and genuine curiosity — you like figuring out how things work and making them work better
Ease with ambiguity and a bias toward action; this role requires you to create the playbook, not execute someone else's
Demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and drive aggressive timelines — ideally with client-facing or health system-facing experience
Ability to speak ‘multiple languages’ – comfort going deep on technical details while communicating clearly to non-technical audiences; you can write a bug ticket, an SOP, and a launch plan that people actually follow; hands-on EHR configuration and integration experience strongly preferred
Analytical enough to build a dashboard and identify a pattern, even if you're not a SQL expert
What Success Looks Like
In your first 90 days, you've audited our current Athena configuration, identified gaps, and have a remediation plan. You understand the bug triage process well enough to have improved it. You've met your counterparts at every health system partner and know what's coming for the next Epic integration.
At six months, new market launches have a repeatable systems and product checklist. Clinic teams know what to expect before a feature goes live. Bug resolution time is measurably faster and the field is no longer sending issues into a black hole.
At one year, the SOP library is comprehensive, clinical systems configuration is stable and documented, and you've successfully navigated at least one new health system EHR environment. The product team has a reliable partner and the ops team isn't dependent on any single person for systems knowledge.

Midjourney is an independent research lab exploring new mediums of thought and expanding the imaginative powers of the human species. We are a small, self-funded team focused on design, human infrastructure, and AI.
Most of the products we build don’t have obvious precedents. We need product managers who can help teams navigate that uncertainty, make decisions, and turn ambitious ideas into products people can actually use.

You’ll work closely with design, engineering, and research throughout the product development process, using tools like Claude Code to prototype concepts. You’ll help teams stay organized, make thoughtful decisions, and move projects from early ideation to launch.
This is a hands-on role. Some days you’ll be writing product specs, running standups, and coordinating launches. Other days you’ll be interviewing users, reviewing prototypes, or digging into product questions that need deeper investigation. If you enjoy bringing structure to creative work and making it easier for great teams to do their best work, you’ll probably enjoy it here.

Own the execution of major product initiatives.
Partner closely with design and engineering from early exploration through launch.
Write product requirements, manage backlogs, and keep projects moving.
Facilitate planning, standups, reviews, and comms between teams.
Help teams make informed decisions through UXR, research, and using Midjourney deeply yourself.
Go deep on important product questions when needed, whether that means conducting user research, designing experiments, or working through a difficult product tradeoff.
Help teams decide what matters most and make smart choices about quality, scope, and speed.
You might be a fit if
You’ve spent the last several years building software people love to use.
You know how to create structure without weighing a team down.
You’re as comfortable writing a product spec as you are talking to users or reviewing a prototype.
You have a point of view, but care more about getting the product right than being right.
Using Claude Code and Cursor are part of your workflow.
You’re excited to build products that don’t come with established playbooks.
Work > ego

Netlify runs on usage. Developers buy credits, teams consume compute and bandwidth, and enterprises commit to spend. The Accounts and Billing area owns how all of that works: the accounts foundation every customer signs into, the billing platform that meters and charges them, and the pricing and packaging model that sets what they pay. It sits at the center of how Netlify grows, and it touches Finance, Growth, UX, Sales, and the executive team.
As a Staff Product Manager, you’ll help define and evolve Netlify’s monetization model, bringing a strong point of view while partnering across the company to make high-impact decisions, and you will build hands-on next to engineering, Finance, and design rather than run a team from above. You’ll collaborate closely with senior leaders, including the CEO and CFO, as we continue to evolve Netlify’s pricing and packaging strategy.

Lead the strategy and evolution of pricing, packaging, and monetization, including plans and tiers, the credit and usage model, seat-versus-consumption economics, on-demand and overage rates, enterprise commitments and discounting, storage pricing, regional pricing, and annual plans.
Ship billing as a product: metering accuracy, invoicing, payments, refunds, and customer-facing usage visibility, including the billing and usage interfaces enterprises are asking for.
Steward the accounts foundation: sign-up and authentication, identity, orgs and teams and seats, roles and permissions, account security, and fraud and abuse at the top of the funnel.
Build and lead the pricing and packaging experimentation program, using data, customer insight, and sound judgment to guide decisions: product analytics, conversion and activation, and credit-consumption telemetry.
Partner with Finance to develop pricing approaches that balance customer value, business goals, and long-term sustainability.
Partner with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders to set priorities, evaluate tradeoffs, and drive alignment on the most impactful opportunities when demand exceeds capacity.

7+ years of product management experience, including experience leading pricing, packaging, monetization, or other commercially significant product initiatives for developer-focused, SaaS, or usage-based products.
Deep experience with usage-based, credit-based, subscription, or seat-based business models, including metering, tiering, overages, enterprise commitments, discounting, and the tradeoffs among them.
Hands-on depth with billing platforms (Orb, Stripe, Zuora, Metronome, or similar), billing pipelines and ledgers, and billing treated as a customer-facing surface.
A track record of driving measurable business outcomes, including revenue impact, through product strategy, experimentation, and execution.
Comfort in ambiguity - You identify missing information, frame tradeoffs, develop a point of view, and bring clear recommendations forward when decisions matter.
Demonstrated ability to influence decisions across Finance, Sales, UX, and Engineering, and to partner effectively with senior leaders and executives.
You balance analytics, customer understanding, and product judgment without over-indexing on any one input.
This Role Is a Great Fit If
You have experience monetizing AI, agent, inference, or other usage-based products, including familiarity with token, credit, or consumption-based pricing models.
You have stood up international and regional pricing and non-US payment methods.
You enjoy operating at the intersection of product, finance, and go-to-market strategy.
You’re energized by the opportunity to shape how a business grows, partner with senior leaders, and remain deeply engaged in the product work that makes it happen.

About Netlify
Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible.

As a Product Manager focused on Meta Systems for VALORANT Mobile, you will help shape the out-of-match experience that supports players before, between, and after every tactical fight.

Drive the product direction and execution support for VALORANT Mobile meta systems, including progression, social, party-up, asset display, player identity, and other out-of-match player experiences.
